stories.title: Write 'JB Shopping Guide: Budget Hauls & Bargaining Tips' Blog Post with Product Schema
stories.description: Create a detailed shopping guide for backpackers visiting Johor Bahru, covering night markets (Pasar Tun Dr. Ismail), malls (Aeon), and street markets with specific store names, item prices, bargaining tips, and opening hours. Publish at /blog/jb-shopping-guide with Product schema markup for recommended items and LocalBusiness schema for shops. Target long-tail keywords: 'cheap shopping JB', 'JB markets for backpackers'.

Product schema markup embeds for 5+ recommended items (e.g., batik shirts, local snacks) with price, currency, and store name
Post includes LocalBusiness schema for 3+ key shopping venues with address, phone, openingHoursSpecification

File to update: site/lib/schema.ts — add generateProductSchema() for items with price and priceCurrency fields

Test command: npm run build && npm run test -- schema.test.ts (validate Product and LocalBusiness schemas)

stories.title: Add Native Blog Post Comments System with Honeypot Spam Protection
stories.description: Implement a native comment system for blog posts (no third-party Disqus) with form validation, honeypot anti-spam field, and moderation queue. Comments display below each post with author name, avatar, timestamp, and content. Moderators review pending comments before publishing. Store comments in database with soft-delete for retention. Add Comment and CommentAction schema markup for Google rich results.
acceptanceCriteria: Blog post footer displays comment form with name, email, website (optional), and comment textarea; form includes hidden honeypot field 'url' that triggers rejection if filled
Submitted comments appear in moderation queue; moderators approve/reject via admin panel; approved comments display with author name and timestamp
Post page renders CommentAction schema for approved comments with author, text, dateCreated, and parentItem reference to Article
technicalNotes: File to create: site/components/CommentForm.tsx (form with honeypot validation and client-side error handling)
File to create: site/app/api/comments/route.ts (POST endpoint validating honeypot, returning 400 if filled)

stories.title: Add Blog Post Difficulty & Duration Tags for Travel Guide Filtering
stories.description: Extend blog post front matter to include metadata tags for travel guides: difficulty (Easy/Medium/Hard), duration (30min/1day/3days), and activity type (Shopping/Nightlife/Cultural). Create a blog sidebar filter UI allowing readers to view posts matching selected difficulty and duration. Update blog index page to show filtered post cards. Implement URL query params for sharing filtered views (e.g., /blog?difficulty=easy&duration=1day).
acceptanceCriteria: Blog post front matter includes difficulty: 'easy', duration: '1day', activity: ['shopping', 'food'] tags; posts render with visible tags on cards
Blog sidebar displays filter checkboxes for difficulty levels and durations; clicking filters updates URL params and displayed posts in real-time
Shareable filter link /blog?difficulty=easy&duration=30min filters correctly; page title updates to 'Easy Activities (30 min)'
